tools.name: flow_search
tools.returns: Search underlyings by ticker fragment

tools.name: list_active_underlyings
tools.returns: Every underlying that traded options on a date, ranked by premium

tools.name: expirations
tools.returns: Available expiration dates for an underlying, with contract counts

tools.name: flow_feed
tools.returns: Recent scored trades (Flow Score, FlowBonus) + VWF/SDF/FIR aggregates

tools.name: trade_score
tools.returns: Full scoring + context for one trade id (from a `flow_feed` row)

tools.name: aggregate_score
tools.returns: Composite + VWF/SDF/FIR across one or more trailing timeframes

tools.name: flow_aggregate
tools.returns: Server-side rollup over an arbitrary `[start_time, end_time]` window

tools.name: sweeps
tools.returns: Aggregated multi-exchange sweeps with venues, premium, moneyness, score

tools.name: flow_momentum
tools.returns: Live 5m/30m/1h flow vs trailing baseline, with z-scores + trend label

tools.name: flow_baseline
tools.returns: Trailing per-time-of-day baseline `flow_momentum` compares against

tools.name: flow_strikes
tools.returns: Top-N strikes by net/total premium with bull/bear split + OI context

tools.name: flow_tide
tools.returns: Bucketed bullish vs bearish premium with cumulative net premium

tools.name: by_strike
tools.returns: Strike-level distribution of a day's flow, optionally by DTE band

tools.name: top_underlyings_daily
tools.returns: Top underlyings by single-day flow (call/put split, net premium, ratio)

tools.name: top_underlyings_weekly
tools.returns: Same, over the trailing week

tools.name: top_contracts_daily
tools.returns: Single-day top-contract screener (premium / volume / OI / sweeps)

tools.name: top_contracts_weekly
tools.returns: Same, over the trailing week

tools.name: unusual_volume
tools.returns: Contracts with anomalous volume vs an `avg_period` baseline (RVOL)

tools.name: unusual_oi
tools.returns: Contracts with significant open-interest changes (opening vs closing)

tools.name: chain_bull_bear
tools.returns: Chain-level bull/bear/neutral % with call- and put-only breakdowns

tools.name: contract_bull_bear
tools.returns: Bull/bear/neutral % for a single OPRA contract

tools.name: chain_ratio
tools.returns: Chain-level ask/bid/mid + aggression ratios with a bias interpretation

tools.name: contract_ratio
tools.returns: Same bid/ask/mid pressure for a single OPRA contract

tools.name: underlying_stats
tools.returns: Daily aggregate stats for an underlying (premium, volume, net, OI)

tools.name: underlying_bulk_stats
tools.returns: One-day stats (premium, volume, call/put split, net premium) for up to 50 tickers in one call; tickers with no options activity are absent

tools.name: contract_bulk_stats
tools.returns: One-day stats for up to 50 option contracts (OPRA symbols) in one call

tools.name: underlying_history
tools.returns: Daily options-flow history for a ticker, one row per trading day (premium, volume, call/put split, net premium)

tools.name: contract_history
tools.returns: Daily history for one contract: premium, volume, OI change, bid/ask split, sweep and multi-leg share, VWAP, last price, IV, trade count

tools.name: flow_historical_compare
tools.returns: Today's flow vs its trailing 20-trading-day average: deltas, percentile ranks and the five most similar past days

tools.name: contract_stats
tools.returns: Daily aggregate stats for a contract (volume, OI, premium, IV)

tools.name: vol_oi
tools.returns: Vol/OI accumulation analysis; distinguishes new positioning from closing

tools.name: moneyness
tools.returns: Premium/sentiment split across deep_itm…deep_otm + detected patterns

tools.name: option_chain
tools.returns: Full chain at an expiration (per-strike call/put volume, OI, premium)

tools.name: underlying_chart
tools.returns: Intraday OHLC-style bars for an underlying

tools.name: contract_chart
tools.returns: Intraday OHLC-style bars for a single contract

tools.name: underlying_rvol
tools.returns: Relative-volume bars for an underlying (`format=summary` for stats only)

tools.name: contract_rvol
tools.returns: Relative-volume bars for a single contract

tools.name: market_overview
tools.returns: Market-wide flow for the day + top tickers by premium

tools.name: market_tide
tools.returns: Bucketed net call/put premium time series with an SPY overlay

tools.name: market_breadth
tools.returns: SPY/QQQ/IWM sentiment, advance/decline, per-sector rotation

tools.name: sector_flow
tools.returns: Sector/industry flow aggregation with top-contributor tickers

tools.name: dark_pool_trades
tools.returns: Paginated off-exchange prints (filters: tickers / date range / notional / venue / sector); `$1M+` by default, span capped at 31 days

tools.name: dark_pool_top_prints
tools.returns: Top-N largest prints for a ticker over a trailing window, ordered by notional

tools.name: heat_heatmap
tools.returns: Current per-strike gamma/vanna heatmap + live velocity (multi-symbol)

tools.name: heat_levels
tools.returns: Key levels only: classified nodes (king, gatekeeper, pika, barney, significant), strongest first, with distance from spot

tools.name: heat_historical_heatmap
tools.returns: Replay the heatmap at a past instant (up to 365 days back)

tools.name: heat_stats_daily
tools.returns: Daily gamma/vanna stats for up to 50 symbols over up to 31 days (400 symbol-days): spot OHLC, largest positive and negative strike exposure, concentration

tools.name: heat_symbols
tools.returns: Every symbol with gamma/vanna data: index flag, previous tickers after a rename, available metrics and history date range

tools.name: tempest_iv
tools.returns: Constant-maturity IV (SVX) at 1d/9d/30d/3m/6m, IV rank and percentiles, ratio to the VIX, term slope and mean-reversion odds

tools.name: tempest_term
tools.returns: Implied vol per listed expiry, for contango/backwardation reads

tools.name: tempest_cones
tools.returns: The 1-sigma move priced from the current price to today's close, 1 day, the week, monthly opex and 30 days, as percent and price bands, with the upside and downside moves as skew prices them and the scheduled events inside each horizon (earnings, FOMC, CPI, NFP); plus fixed day, week and month ranges priced at a past close

tools.name: tempest_sigma
tools.returns: Today's move in units of the one-day move priced at the prior close, move budget left, odds of 1- and 2-sigma days, last 60 sessions

tools.name: tempest_surface
tools.returns: 30-day 25-delta risk reversal and butterfly, ATM vol, skew percentile, a per-symbol SKEW index and the smile per expiry

tools.name: tempest_tilt
tools.returns: One-strike-OTM call vs put imbalance (raw and forward-adjusted), the cheap side, z-score and percentile

tools.name: tempest_events
tools.returns: Next earnings date and timing, implied event move vs past realized moves, VRP and 20-day realized vol

tools.name: tempest_snapshot
tools.returns: Every Tempest module in one call (iv, term, cones, sigma, surface, tilt, events)

tools.name: tempest_market
tools.returns: VIX1D/9D/VIX/3M/6M, VVIX and SKEW from SPX and VIX chains, curve state and roll, regime, Mag-7 dispersion, Fear & Greed

tools.name: tempest_screener
tools.returns: Radar: screen every covered symbol on IV rank, SVX percentiles, ratio to VIX, skew, tilt, expected move, sigma, day pace and vol repricing, earnings, VRP; up to 500 rows

tools.name: tempest_history
tools.returns: One row per stored session at its close (OHLC, SVX per tenor, ATM vol, term slope, skew, tilt, chain depth), up to about two years
tools.credits: 1 per 10 symbol-weekdays in the window, min 1 (3 for 1 symbol x 1 month)

tools.name: tempest_derived
tools.returns: One year daily: 20-day realized vol, VRP series and percentile, the SVX30 usual-range band, earnings-eve sessions, spot-vol correlation

tools.name: tempest_status
tools.returns: When Tempest last computed, the session it belongs to, whether it is serving the frozen close, market state and coverage counts

tools.name: tempest_symbols
tools.returns: Every symbol Tempest covers, with its latest asOf and last stored daily session

tools.name: account_usage
tools.returns: Balance in credits and US dollars, unlimited flag, and the limits that apply

tools.name: explain_levels
tools.returns: Key dealer-positioning levels for one symbol: spot, King node, flip, largest positive and negative walls, net exposure, five largest levels

tools.name: vol_context
tools.returns: 30-day implied volatility, IV rank, 1-year percentile and range, curve shape, 1-sigma expected moves by horizon (from the current price), scheduled events

tools.name: whats_changed
tools.returns: How one symbol's board moved since an earlier instant: spot move, King node then and now, the five strikes whose net exposure changed most

tools.name: market_brief
tools.returns: VIX complex (computed from the SPX and VIX option chains), market-wide options flow (premium, call/put ratio, net premium, most active) and key levels for SPXW (S&P 500 dailies and weeklies, 0DTE included, as in the app's Trinity view) and QQQ

tools.name: flow_context
tools.returns: Today's flow read for one ticker: bull/bear split and bias, sweep counts and premium, largest recent dark-pool prints
